_description: General on-screen text for the game. 'start' = the first screen (needed so the browser allows sound): 'prompt' is the main line, 'soundNote' the smaller line under it. 'title' = the opening page: 'heading' is the big game name, 'tagline' is an optional line under it (leave "" to hide), 'enterButton' is the button label, 'hint' is the small text under the button.
